learning_objective: 🎯 Adapt your writing for the digital age! Discover how to write engaging blogs, web content, and social media posts for audiences with short attention spans.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: People don't read web pages like books; they *scan* them. They look for bold words, bullet points, and subheadings. If a web page looks like a giant wall of text, the reader will click away instantly.
A blog (web-log) is an updated online journal or informational website. Blog writing is usually more conversational, personal, and direct than traditional journalism.

Print is linear (you read top to bottom). Web writing is non-linear. You can use hyperlinks to send readers to background information, definitions, or related articles without cluttering your main text.
To get people to read your content, search engines (like Google) need to find it. Writers must strategically use 'Keywords'—the exact words people type into search bars—in their titles and text.
New media isn't just text. A good digital writer knows how to embed images, infographics, podcasts, and videos directly into the article to make it highly engaging and shareable.

fun_activity.title: 📱 The Fairy Tale Tweet
fun_activity.instructions: Take a famous, long fairy tale (like Cinderella or Little Red Riding Hood). Your challenge is to summarize the entire story into a single, catchy, modern social media post using fewer than 280 characters. Don't forget the hashtags!

exam_tips: 📌 When asked to draft a blog post, always include a catchy title, short paragraphs, bulleted lists, and a 'Call to Action' (e.g., 'Comment below with your thoughts!') at the end.
📌 Remember the 'F-Pattern'. Eye-tracking studies show web users scan screens in the shape of an 'F'. Put your most important information at the top and left side of the page.
📌 Web writing must be concise. Cut out unnecessary filler words. Get straight to the point.
quick_recap: ⭐ Web readers are impatient; write for scannability.
⭐ Hyperlinks turn passive reading into an interactive, choose-your-own-adventure experience.
⭐ Good new media writing perfectly blends text, images, and video.
